title: Titan Pro 15K Watermelon Ice Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Watermelon Ice delivers a fresh, delicately sweet Watermelon flavour followed by a clean, icy finish. Smooth and bright, it’s a crisp and refreshing all-day vape. Each Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml pod and 10ml refill container for the Titan Pro 15K device. The mesh coil ensures clear vapour production and steady coil performance for consistent flavour delivery. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
